## The problem

What are you trying to do that is hard or impossible today?

## The idea

Describe the feature or change you have in mind. If it is an engine or scripting
feature, a short example of how it would be used helps a lot:

```lua
-- how it might look
```

## Alternatives

Any other approaches you considered, including whether this can already be done
with the existing Lua API in `docs/`.

## Notes

Anything else, such as how Create Your Frisk or Undertale handles this, or
whether it belongs upstream in the engine rather than in Soulbound.
